description: This PHP source file defines the 'Country' controller class within the OpenCart admin task namespace. The class manages operations related to country data, including generating country files, listing countries across stores, fetching specific country info, deleting files, and clearing cache. It interacts with models for tasks, localization, stores, settings, zones, and geo zones, and handles file operations for JSON data related to countries.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Controller class managing country data tasks in OpenCart admin panel, including generating, listing, retrieving info, deleting, and clearing country-related JSON files.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates tasks to clear, list, and fetch info for all countries.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates country list data for all stores and languages.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Generates detailed country information, including zones and geo zones.

methods.name: countries
methods.description: Generates country list files for a specific store and language.

methods.name: country
methods.description: Retrieves and generates detailed info for a specific country across stores and languages.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes country JSON files and related cache files.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears generated country JSON files and cache.
